title: Smooth fibrewise dual bundle
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real manifold [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold] and $E\to N$ a smooth rank-$q$ real vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. The dual bundle $E^*\to N$ is the smooth bundle with fibre $E_x^*=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf R,\mathrm{cont}}(E_x,\mathbf R)$, the continuous real-linear maps $E_x\to\mathbf R$; these are all real-linear maps because the fibres are finite-dimensional Hausdorff vector spaces. Its local trivializations are the duals of those of $E$: if vector coordinates change by $v_j=g_{ji}(x)v_i$, covector column coordinates change by $\lambda_j=g_{ji}(x)^{-\mathsf T}\lambda_i$. Evaluation is the fibrewise map $(\lambda,v)\mapsto\lambda(v)$.
